delete.description: Delete the dataset for good. Owners only.

get.description:
The dataset's record as a downloadable file. Incomplete records are refused with 422.

Export does not run the official checks; `validate` does.

200.description: The record in the requested serialisation

post.description: Record that the metadata was checked today and move the next reminder a year ahead.

put.description:
Set, change or clear the date the caller is reminded to revalidate the metadata.

Any member can do this. It does not change the metadata, so the dataset's version and
last-changed time stay as they are.

post.description:
Check the record against the official Health DCAT-AP shapes for its access level.

`conforms` is true only when nothing is missing and no rule is broken (warnings do not
count). Without an access level there is no shape set to check against, so only the
missing fields are reported.

Owners only. Emails the invitee, by name and with the optional message, a link that is
valid for 30 days.

delete.description: Cancel a pending invitation; its link stops working.

post.description:
Send a new link (the old one stops working) and restart the 30 days.

Works on pending and expired invitations.
